title: Barrierefreiheitserklärung Check (BFSG, BITV)

title: SQL Server Docker Licence Lint (MSSQL_PID)
description: Lints docker-compose, Kubernetes YAML and Dockerfiles that run the mssql/server image for SQL Server licence gaps: MSSQL_PID unset or Developer in production, Evaluation, core minimums and caps.

title: RDS Extended Support Cost Lint for Terraform
description: Flags aws_db_instance and Aurora clusters in Terraform whose MySQL/PostgreSQL major version is past AWS standard support, and prices the per-vCPU-hour Extended Support surcharge per year.

title: NuGet License Gate: AutoMapper, MediatR
description: Flags .csproj, Directory.Packages.props and packages.config lines that pull AutoMapper 15+, MediatR 13+, FluentAssertions 8+, MassTransit 9+ or other NuGet versions past their commercial licence line.

title: AVV-Prüfer – Auftragsverarbeitungsvertrag Lint
description: Prüft Auftragsverarbeitungsverträge (AVV/DPA in Markdown) auf die Pflichtinhalte nach Art. 28 Abs. 3 DSGVO, Privacy Shield, alte SCC 2010/87/EU, § 11 BDSG a. F. und 72-Stunden-Meldefristen.
